name: organization
description: Organization model contracts (W039, the possession structure pattern): ARCHITECTURE.md §12 — 'Organization discovers capabilities and composes Bodies.' An Organization is DECLARATIVE DATA + LAWS, never execution: positions (each carrying typed body requirements, substrate requirements and capability demands), a typed composition tree (positions compose into units, units into the organization), possession bindings declared through W034's channel/grant vocabulary on the 'organization' channel, explicit tenant/project/world scope, a deterministic canonical identity (canonical JSON + FNV-1a over the whole definition — same bytes, same id, A9) and an immutable lineage (every derived organization cites its parent; genesis is the only root). Fail-closed validation names every law loudly (unknown capability reference, position without requirements, cyclic composition, duplicate ids, scope mismatch). Ablation-readiness (R053 + §13): typed PURE operations — remove a position/unit (the 'organization' ablation axis) or substitute a body/substrate requirement (the 'model-substitution' axis) — each producing a NEW valid definition with a derived identity; W036's ABLATION_KINDS is the closed origin-kind table. No execution, no runtime, no model calls.
